items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: And when I got out, and went to the Benny Morton band... And when I left the Blue Devils, I went to Benny Morton.

ctx.x: And when I got out, and went to the Benny Morton band, that's where the trouble started. Because they were using three-part harmony, and we got Lips Page to come in, so like the chord or the tonic third and the fifth, I added in the sixth. And the band didn't want to hear that. They'd say, that's out of tune, no.
